Charles Robert Maturin, Melmoth the Wanderer.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/charles-robert-maturin/melmoth-the-wanderer

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Charles Robert Maturin, the author, died 1824.

First publication of the text used: 1820 (SE colophon: 'Melmoth the Wanderer was published in 1820 by Charles Robert Maturin.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1820, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1915.
- Country of origin (United Kingdom, where the text was first published): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die did so in 1824, so the work entered the public domain there on 1 January 1895.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
